title: What after the Bachelor?
description: After the Bachelor in Informatics you can continue your studies by enrolling to one of the seven Master's Degrees offered by the Faculty. Pick yours.

blocks.html:
The Faculty of Informatics currently offers seven Master's degrees:

  • Master of Science in Informatics
  • Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence
  • Master of Science in Data Sicence
  • Master of Science in Software Engineering with AI
  • Master of Science in Management and Informatics *
  • Master of Science in Financial Technology and Computing *

The Faculty of Informatics offers the opportunity to carry out a part of the programme of the Master in Informatics and the Master in Data Science at a partner university, in order to obtain a double degree conferred by USI and the chosen partner university.

(*) These programmes are offered in collaboration with the Faculty of Economics.

items.title: Research summer internships for students - UROP Internships
items.html:
The Faculty of Informatics encourages and promotes the talent of its Bachelor and Master students by offering them summer internships in academic research within the programme Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program - UROP.

Internships are extracurricular, and access is on a competitive basis. Students work one-on-one with an advisor to develop a deeper understanding of both the concepts taught during the semester and the research topic. Students considering continuing in academia should seriously consider applying for a UROP position.
